maddeler.e: جَهْبَذ or جِهْبِذ • (jahbaḏ or jihbiḏ) (feminine جَهْبَذَة (jahbaḏa) or جِهْبِذَة (jihbiḏa), masculine plural جَهَابِذَة (jahābiḏa), feminine plural جَهْبَذَات (jahbaḏāt) or جِهْبِذَات (jihbiḏāt))
maddeler.t: From Middle Persian [script needed] (*gēhbad, “property manager”) from Old Persian [script needed] (*gaiθāpati-, “overseer of the livestock”). Compare Persian گهبُد (gahbod).
s: Old Persian [script needed] (*gaiθāpati-, “overseer of the livestock”)
